strings.Berpusat dekat permukaan kerak bumi, kel: Centred close to the surface of the crust, depth class {0} to {1} km. Energy released at this depth is barely damped by the rock above it, so shallow quakes are the class most often felt at the surface and the most likely to cause damage; a tsunami only happens when a shallow quake under the sea lifts the seafloor, so not every shallow quake triggers one.
strings.Berpusat di kedalaman {0} sampai {1} km,: Centred at a depth of {0} to {1} km, the intermediate class. The distance from the surface damps the energy more than in shallow quakes, so the shaking that reaches the surface is usually weaker for the same magnitude; quakes this deep also rarely trigger a tsunami.

strings.<strong>Cara menghitung nilai:</strong>: How scores are computed: Each student answers one set of questions. PISA does not infer a single score, but score estimates per student (the official term: plausible values). Means and their uncertainty are computed from different resampled versions (the official term: Balanced Repeated Replication, or BRR, with Fay's coefficient).
strings.<strong>Lisensi dan pembuatan ulang:</st: Licence and rebuilding: The data comes from the official OECD PISA repository under a Creative Commons Attribution International licence (CC BY ). This page is rebuilt automatically from the same data, and fetches nothing from the internet when it is opened.
strings.<strong>Yang tidak bisa disimpulkan:</st: What cannot be concluded: The numbers on this page describe students as a whole; they do not rate particular schools or students, and they do not prove cause and effect.
